name: crux-growth-skills
description: Free Crux skills, best with a Crux Growth Brain connected. Plan Black Friday on your own data, and diagnose why a KPI moved between two periods.

interface.shortDescription: Crux Black Friday planning and performance diagnosis
interface.longDescription: Read last year's Black Friday on your own data, test your November and December targets against it, and agree a plan with day-by-day targets you can download. Diagnose why a KPI moved between two periods, split into its levers, with the main driver found and what to do about it.
defaultPrompt: Why did my revenue drop last month?
